name: Burning Skull
body:
School evocation; Level psychic 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (pinch of saltpeter)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Targets one creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude half and Reflex (see description); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You turn the target’s skull into a conflagration from the inside out. The target takes 6d6 fire damage and is blinded. They then catch on fire taking 3d6 fire each round. The target remains blinded for as long as they are on fire. A successful initial Fortitude save halves the fire damage and negates the blinding and catching on fire. Then each round they can attempt to put out the fire with a Reflex save against this spell’s DC. The ongoing fire damage does not stack with other fire damage dealt from being on fire.
